depends_on: Kepler conjecture (Hales 2005; Flyspeck formal proof 2017, not in Lean)
notes: lim f_3(n)/n^(1/3) = (3 sqrt2/pi)^(1/3) = 1.10533. Upper: n fcc points in a ball. Lower: cut space into cubes of side sqrt D; Kepler applied to a periodic repeat of each cube bounds its points by sqrt2 (s+1)^3; the isodiametric inequality bounds the number of cubes meeting the hull. Outside Lean: everything (Kepler theorem, isodiametric inequality, cube averaging, lattice count); fcc construction checked numerically by certificate/fcc_ball.py.
